discrepancy_reconciliation_summary.discrepancy_identified: Previous post-promotion checkpoint text stated 'T_pub <= t0 (22:00 UTC Day D-1)' and 'Latest Causal Observation: 22:00 UTC Day D-1'. This conflated the latest observation timestamp (22:00 UTC D-1 = t0 - 2h) with the benchmark forecast origin (t0 = 00:00:00 UTC Day D).
discrepancy_reconciliation_summary.authoritative_reconciliation: The benchmark forecast origin t0 is authoritatively 00:00:00 UTC Day D. ABIS observation time is 22:00 UTC Day D-1 (t0 - 2h) and publication time is 23:30 UTC Day D-1 (t0 - 30m). Thus T_pub <= t0 is fully satisfied with a 30-minute causal safety buffer.

second_governance_lock.lock_name: Second Governance Lock — No Feature Grinding
second_governance_lock.rule_text: Future research must prioritize genuinely independent information sources. Experiments that merely re-parameterize, spatially differentiate without strong independent justification, repackage existing signals, add neighboring grid statistics, or increase model complexity on redundant data are strictly prohibited.
